text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Seriously?
You've gotten damn strong, Dantsu...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Before, it felt like she didn't quite have what it takes to take center stage.
Like she was just an errand girl of sorts, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Geez... You're not who you were back then, are you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're doing splendidly,
as one of the pillars carrying the mile division on your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I wanted to look all smug
and proud just like Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan, you've gotten way, way, waaaay
cooler than before, too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...! Getting to run side by side like this.
And also~...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I might feel a little lonely... knowing that starting tomorrow, I won't be able to run as much again.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, don't look so down. As long as we
both blow everyone away on the track, that's all that matters, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Our running turfs may have split apart...
but the times we ran through together were no lie.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's not like the memories are gonna disappear too, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Racing might be a matter of survival. But we can survive it with our heads held high, right?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll do my best.
So stay well too, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That powerful run you showed me today—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking it all the way
to the autumn Japan Cup!
